problem.explanation: A year is a leap year if it is evenly divisible by 4 AND (it is not evenly divisible by 100 OR it is evenly divisible by 400). This logic can be condensed into a single return statement.
hints: Use the modulo operator `%` to test for divisibility.
problem.reference_solution:
def is_leap_year(year: int) -> bool:
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
problem.statement_markdown: Write a function `is_leap_year(year: int) -> bool` that determines whether a given year is a leap year. A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4, but not by 100, unless it is also divisible by 400.
problem.title: Leap year
